Landing.badge: Home finance control with an AI assistant
Landing.heroSubtitle: Scrooge is a home budgeting app. Budget vs. actuals, liabilities, investments, taxes, savings goals, an AI assistant — all in one place, secure and private.
Landing.screensSubtitle: One app, a complete picture of your finances — from monthly budget to investment portfolio.
Landing.featuresSubtitle: Years of running a home budget in Excel spreadsheets, redesigned as a modern web app.

features.title: Budget vs. Actuals
features.description: Plan a monthly budget with templates and track spending in real time. Instant alerts when you go over plan.

features.title: AI Financial Assistant
features.description: Ask about your finances in plain language. Bring your own LLM — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or a custom provider.

features.title: Liabilities, Taxes & Enforcement
features.description: Track loans, credit, instalments and subscriptions, tax settlements and enforcement proceedings — all in one place.

features.title: Investments
features.description: Track your portfolio: stocks, bonds, ETFs, crypto, precious metals, deposits and more — with one aggregated value.

features.title: Savings Goals
features.description: Set financial goals and monitor progress towards them as you go.

features.title: Trend Analysis
features.description: Spot spending patterns across months and years. Forecasts based on real data — up to 10 years of history.

features.title: Interactive Charts & Reports
features.description: Ready-made charts: cost breakdown, income, overspending. Export data for further analysis.

features.title: Excel Data Import
features.description: Import your transaction history from an Excel spreadsheet. Deduplication and preview before it's saved.

features.title: Security
features.description: Passwordless login (OTP), Row Level Security in Supabase. Your data is visible only to you.

steps.title: Sign in with email
steps.description: Enter your email and get a one-time code. No passwords to remember.

steps.title: Set up categories and accounts
steps.description: Set up a category hierarchy (Food > Restaurants), add your bank accounts, cash, crypto and investments.

steps.title: Plan your budget
steps.description: Create a budget template and generate monthly plans from it. Import your history from Excel.

steps.title: Track and analyse
steps.description: Log transactions, browse charts, ask the AI assistant about your finances. Stay on top of it.

Landing.securityBody: Passwordless login (OTP), encrypted data in Supabase, Row Level Security — no one but you can access your finances. AI conversations are stored locally on your device.
Landing.ctaTitle: Ready to take control of your finances?
Landing.ctaSubtitle: Scrooge is launching soon. Join the waitlist and be first in line when we open access.

Privacy.s1p1: The controller of personal data processed in connection with the use of the Scrooge app (the “App”, the “Service”) is:
Privacy.s1block:
[TO BE COMPLETED: full legal name and form of the Service Provider]
[TO BE COMPLETED: registered address]
[TO BE COMPLETED: Tax ID / company registration number]
Contact for data protection matters: [TO BE COMPLETED: contact email address]
Privacy.s1p2: Throughout this document, the Controller is referred to as “we”, and the person using the App as the “User” or “you”.
Privacy.s2intro: Depending on how you use the App, we process:
s2items: Account data — the email address used for passwordless login (one-time OTP code) via Supabase Auth.

Financial data you enter — transactions (date, amount, type, description, tags), accounts (bank, cash, crypto, funds, insurance policies), categories, monthly budgets, liabilities (loans, instalments, subscriptions), savings goals, investments, taxes and enforcement proceedings — to the extent you enter them into the App yourself or import them from an Excel file.
Data from Excel import files — processed solely to populate your transactions; the source file is not retained once the import completes.
Data from the waitlist sign-up form — first name, email address, and the timestamp of the consent given to be contacted.
Data from feature requests and roadmap votes — the content of the submission, and optionally a name and email address if provided.

AI assistant settings and API keys — if you enable the AI assistant, its configuration (including your own API key for the chosen provider) is stored only locally in your browser (localStorage) and never reaches our database.
AI assistant conversation content — likewise stored only locally on your device; our database stores only session metadata (title, model, message count), never the message content.
Technical data — IP address and request timestamps, used short-term to protect public forms from abuse (rate limiting).
Privacy.s3title: 3. Purposes and legal bases for processing
s3items: Providing the Service (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) — creating and running your account, storing and displaying your financial data, generating charts and reports.
Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) — the waitlist sign-up and contact about the product launch; you can withdraw consent at any time.
The Controller's legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) — App security, abuse prevention (rate limiting), maintaining service continuity, pursuing legal claims.
Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR) — where required by law (e.g. handling complaints).
Privacy.s4intro: Your data may be processed by the following parties, strictly to the extent necessary to provide the Service:
s4items: Supabase — provider of the PostgreSQL database and authentication mechanism (OTP login).
Vercel — provider of the hosting and serverless infrastructure the App runs on.

The AI provider you choose (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or another OpenAI-API-compatible provider) — only if you configure and use the AI assistant yourself. In that case, the content of your query is sent directly to the chosen provider to generate a response. This transfer may involve moving data outside the European Economic Area — we recommend reviewing the chosen provider's privacy policy before using this feature.
Privacy.s4outro: We do not sell your data and do not share it with third parties for marketing purposes.
s5items: Account and financial data — for as long as you hold an account in the App.
Transactions you delete are marked as deleted (not visible in the App) and permanently removed when the account is deleted.
Waitlist data — until consent is withdrawn or the product publicly launches, plus a reasonable period afterwards.
Technical data used for abuse protection — no longer than 30 days.
Privacy.s6intro: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
s6items: erasure of data ("the right to be forgotten"),
data portability — you can export your transactions and budget from the App to an Excel/CSV file at any time,
withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before its withdrawal,
lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (PUODO).
Privacy.s6outro: To exercise the rights above, including the right to delete your account and all associated data, write to us at: [TO BE COMPLETED: contact email address]. Account deletion is currently handled manually by the administrator after verifying the request.
Privacy.s7p1: Access to financial data is restricted to the User account it belongs to (row-level access control — RLS). Connections to the App are encrypted (HTTPS). AI API keys and AI assistant conversation content are never sent to our servers or stored in our database.
Privacy.s8p1: We use only essential cookies to maintain your login session (Supabase Auth), plus data stored locally in your browser (localStorage) to remember your chosen theme (light/dark), chosen language, AI assistant configuration, and AI assistant conversation content. We do not use advertising or third-party analytics cookies.
Privacy.s9p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes through the App or by email. The date of the last update appears at the top of this document.
Privacy.s10p1: For matters related to personal data protection, contact us at: [TO BE COMPLETED: contact email address].

Terms.s1p1: These Terms of Service set out the rules for using the Scrooge — Home Finance Control app (the “App”, the “Service”), available at usescrooge.com and app.usescrooge.com.
Terms.s1p2: The Service Provider is [TO BE COMPLETED: full legal name and form of the Service Provider], [TO BE COMPLETED: registered address], Tax ID: [TO BE COMPLETED], contact: [TO BE COMPLETED: contact email address] (the “Service Provider”).
Terms.s1p3: The rules for processing personal data are set out separately in the <link>Privacy Policy</link>, which supplements these Terms.
s2items: App / Service — the Scrooge web app for managing a home budget.
User — a natural person using the App.
Account — a User's individual profile in the App, secured by passwordless login (a one-time code sent by email).
AI assistant — an optional App feature using third-party language model providers, configured and paid for by the User themself.
s3items: recording transactions, accounts, categories, and monthly budgets,
tracking liabilities (loans, instalments, subscriptions), savings goals, investments, taxes, and enforcement proceedings,
using the optional AI financial assistant, once the User provides their own API key for the chosen provider,
submitting and voting on proposed new features (roadmap).
Terms.s3outro: The scope of available features may depend on the chosen plan — see the <link>pricing</link> page for details.
Terms.s4p1: Creating an Account requires providing an email address and confirming it with a one-time code (passwordless login). The User is responsible for keeping access to their email inbox confidential — all actions taken after logging into an Account are treated as actions of that User.
Terms.s4p2: Only adults with full legal capacity may use the App.
Terms.s5p1: The App is currently available in a waitlist model ahead of public launch. The intended subscription plans (Free, Basic, Pro) and billing rules will be described in detail before they become available — the current outline is on the <link>pricing</link> page.
s6items: providing truthful information when registering and using the App,
using the App in accordance with the law and good practice,
not attempting unauthorised access to the App or other Users' data,
sole responsibility for the accuracy of financial data entered manually or imported from Excel files,
when using the AI assistant — independently obtaining, configuring, and covering the cost of the API key with the chosen third-party provider, and complying with that provider's terms of use.
Terms.s7p1: The App is a tool that supports financial awareness and does not constitute financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. Financial decisions made based on the data and analyses presented in the App are the User's own responsibility.
Terms.s7p2: The Service Provider is not liable for consequences arising from incorrect or incomplete data entered by the User, errors in imported files, or content generated by the AI assistant, which may contain inaccuracies.
Terms.s7p3: The Service Provider makes reasonable efforts to keep the App running continuously and correctly, but does not guarantee full availability of the Service and reserves the right to technical interruptions, including for maintenance and updates.
Terms.s8p1: Complaints about how the App operates can be submitted to: [TO BE COMPLETED: contact email address]. A complaint should include a description of the issue and the User's contact details. The Service Provider will handle the complaint within 14 days of receiving it.
Terms.s9p1: The User may stop using the App at any time and request deletion of their Account along with associated data by contacting: [TO BE COMPLETED: contact email address]. The rules and retention period for data after account deletion are described in the <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
Terms.s10p1: The App, its code, name, logo, and visual design are the property of the Service Provider and are protected by copyright. Financial data entered by the User remains their own property — the Service Provider processes it solely to provide the Service.
Terms.s11p1: The Service Provider reserves the right to change these Terms for good cause (e.g. a change in the scope of the Service, a change in the law). Users will be notified of changes with reasonable advance notice through the App or by email.
Terms.s12p1: Matters not covered by these Terms are governed by Polish law, including the Civil Code and the Act on the Provision of Electronic Services. Any disputes will be resolved by the competent court in accordance with applicable law.
